output_list.reason: In the transfer function, the balance of the sender is decreased by _amount, and the balance of the receiver is increased by _amount. However, this operation can cause an integer overflow if _amount is large enough. For example, if the sender has a balance of 2^256-1 and tries to transfer 2^256, the balance of the sender will be 2^256 and the balance of the receiver will be 2^256-1. After the transfer, the balance of the sender will be 2^256-1 and the balance of the receiver will be 2^256, which is incorrect.
